meta.ranking: Recommended bets pass every bet rule, ordered by calibrated edge. Watchlist = live-watch spots, ordered by 25D size. Leans and passes ordered by calibrated edge.
rules: 25D score above +1.5 for an over or at most −1.5 for an under.
Projection on the bet side of the line.
Play chance of at least 50%; questionable / game-time decisions wait for status and are never a pregame bet.
Calibrated edge of at least 5 points over the break-even of a confirmed sportsbook price (estimated, DFS and prediction-market prices never qualify).
Projection and line within 50% of each other; a bigger gap is CHECK NEWS, never a bet.

Early season (each team’s first 10 games): only points, rebounds, PRA, P+R, P+A, R+A and turnovers can make the card. In the 2019–26 backtest, strong cards for assists, threes, steals and blocks were close to coin flips in games 1–10.
meta.staking: Model sizing: 1 unit flat (1u = 1% of bankroll). 0.5u for steals, blocks and prices of +300 or longer. Caps: 1.5u per game, 10u per night, 2 bets per team. Live-watch spots are sized by the halftime table.

notes: Fri Oct 30 board: no card bets and no leans. Check-news plays 0-1. Every priced prop on the model side went 16-38, and game lines went 2-8 ATS, 3-7 on totals. That was the worst night so far.
Found the cause: box scores added for Oct 24–29 had no starter flag, so every player looked like he had lost his starting job. Projections came out about 11% low across the board.

Fixed: starters are now inferred from minutes (top five per team) for every 2026-27 game, and that rule is built into the nightly update. Re-scored with the fix, Friday’s projections are unbiased (actual/projected 0.96 vs 1.11 before) and the report cards still track results (correlation 0.33 with how each player did vs his normal).

Tested a new ‘player history’ question on 2024-26: a player’s hit rate over the same line in his last 10/20 games. It adds almost nothing on top of the model, because his history already drives the projection, except for threes, where it now nudges the price. Each priced prop now shows his last-10 and last-20 record against the line.
Pregame prices stay 10% model / 90% line: on the props books price, the line has been at least as accurate as the model in every graded night.
All 21 games from Oct 30–Nov 1 are in the player history.
